meta.notes: POST /webhook/site-clone {action: start|status|cancel, url, options, campaign_id, job_id, sketch_id, opsec, proxy}. Starts an HTTrack clone in the site-clone-api container (options include deobfuscate / deobfuscateTimeout / allowDockerDns, forwarded as-is). The sidecar flattens the frontend proxy envelope and applies OPSEC DNS (proxychains proxy_dns, per-job resolv.conf / DoH stub, fail-closed). Polls status (including the dns label) and on completion writes findings into the campaign sketch and indexes the offline clone tree (mirror/ + deobf/) into the Prompt-tab company-site RAG collection. Live Domain Recon crawling stays removed.
